problems.quote: judgment-linked law (NGT, SC, EPA 1986, WPA 1972, FRA 2006, BDA 2002)
problems.problem: NGT (National Green Tribunal) and SC (Supreme Court) are judicial/quasi-judicial institutions, not laws. The list incorrectly labels them as 'law'.
problems.correction: judgment-linked institutions and laws (NGT, SC, EPA 1986, WPA 1972, FRA 2006, BDA 2002)
problems.verifierReason: NGT and SC are institutions, not statutes; correction clarifies they are institutions alongside actual laws.

problems.quote: impeachment process applicable to the Vice‑President (Article 67(b))
problems.problem: The Vice‑President is removed by a resolution under Article 67(b), not by impeachment. Impeachment is the procedure for removing the President under Article 61.
problems.correction: removal process applicable to the Vice‑President under Article 67(b)
problems.verifierReason: VP removed by resolution under Art. 67(b), not impeachment (Art. 61).

problems.quote: Rojer Mathew v. South Indian Bank (2019)
problems.problem: The case name is misspelled; it is "Roger Mathew v. South Indian Bank Ltd. (2019)".
problems.correction: Roger Mathew v. South Indian Bank Ltd. (2019)
problems.verifierReason: Case name spelled 'Roger', not 'Rojer'; 'Ltd.' part of official name.

problems.quote: about 30 million hectares in 1950 to over 140 million hectares today
problems.problem: The irrigated area in 1950 was approximately 22 million hectares (not 30 million), and the current gross irrigated area is about 100 million hectares (not over 140 million). The figure 140 million hectares refers to the ultimate irrigation potential, not the actual irrigated area.
problems.correction: about 22 million hectares in 1950 to over 100 million hectares today
problems.verifierReason: 1950 irrigated area ~22 M ha; current actual irrigated area ~100 M ha; 140 M ha is potential, not actual.
